mode: Selected existing built-in generated photographs and composed controlled print-design comparisons. No new photograph was generated.
comparisonPolicy: Invitation: only the image x coordinate changes; frame size, crop and all text remain fixed. Peer cards: only the left panel fill and inherited text fill change; the right panel and both photos are untouched. Material study: only the identifier group font-weight changes from 400 to 700; size, family, anchors, baselines and line breaks remain fixed. Shared image bytes, paper and lighting remain identical.

verification.textBounds: within paper or phone content surface, including nested group transforms
verification.pixelCheck: Only intended declared declared balance intervention regions differ.
verification.scope: Saved standalone comparisons at desktop and narrow widths, with text within the paper. Pixel differences verify controlled edits, not perceived balance.

limitations: Proposed balance is contextual editorial interpretation. No calibrated visual-weight score, viewer preference, measured attention/task improvement, physical print trial, assistive-technology test or complete production article route result.
